title: Prepay Catalogue Insert: Booking Windows, Minimums and Price Protection across the Crop Input Purchasing Accounts
content:
Money paid in ahead of the season is taken only on the programmes of Crop Input Purchasing Accounts that carry a prepay window, and each of those programmes fixes its own window, its smallest booking, its ceiling as a share of the prior crop year's input spend, the period after which unapplied money is forfeited, whether money booked against one input class may be drawn against another, and whether booked seed carries price protection.

| Programme | Window opens | Window closes | Smallest booking (USD) | Ceiling (percent of prior-year spend) | Forfeited after (months) | Transferable between input classes | Seed price protection | Protection window (calendar days) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Cash Purchase Account | not offered | not offered | 0 | 0 | 0 | no | no | 0 |
| Standard 30-Day Charge Account | not offered | not offered | 0 | 0 | 0 | no | no | 0 |
| Seasonal Terms Crop Input Account | not offered | not offered | 0 | 0 | 0 | no | no | 0 |
| Early Pay Prepay Program Account | 1 October | 31 December | 5000 | 125 | 24 | yes | yes | 120 |
| Full Acre Input Financing Account | 1 October | 31 December | 10000 | 100 | 24 | yes | yes | 120 |
| Precision Partner Input Program Account | 15 September | 31 December | 25000 | 100 | 36 | yes | yes | 150 |

### How the columns read

The window opens and closes on the month and day shown, and a programme marked not offered takes no prepay at all. The smallest booking is the least the programme will take. The ceiling is the share of the member's input spend in the crop year immediately before the current one that the programme will carry as prepay: 125 percent on the Early Pay Prepay Program Account and 100 percent on the Full Acre Input Financing Account and the Precision Partner Input Program Account. The forfeiture period is counted in months from the close of the booking window the money was taken in, at 24 months on the two mid programmes and 36 months on the Precision Partner Input Program Account. Where a programme is marked transferable, money booked against one input class may be drawn against another.

### Price protection

Where a programme carries seed price protection, booked seed is protected against a later fall in the list price for the number of calendar days shown from the booking: 120 days on the Early Pay Prepay Program Account and the Full Acre Input Financing Account, and 150 days on the Precision Partner Input Program Account. The three programmes of Crop Input Purchasing Accounts that take no prepay carry no price protection and show a protection window of 0 days.
